Records of the protocol (../../README.md) on the seven reference networks: order A (increasing PowerModels branch key) on
the MATPOWER 7.0 case files of benchmarks/instances/fetch_scopf_data.sh <D> (<D>/data_mp70/; the sha256 of each file is
in its screen's meta file and in ../../../instances/scopf_data.sha256). ../../reference_networks.py rebuilds from them the
contingency lists of benchmarks/instances/scopf_contingencies.jl (`lists --check`) and lists.md (`report --check`).

screens/<net>_full_rho1e8.{csv,raw.csv,meta.txt}
                     case118, case300, case_ACTIVSg200, case_ACTIVSg500: julia/screen_run2.jl <D>/data_mp70/<net>.m full Inf
                     <out>/<net>_full_rho1e8 1e8, i.e. every in-service branch in increasing key (order A without a stop
                     rule) at penalty 1e8, admitted iff the scaled ||r||_inf < 1e-4 after at most 200 iterations (any status,
                     bridges kept); screen_s 80.8, 273.0, 158.9, 716.3 s (WO-69 gate S0'). Copied verbatim from branch
                     scopf-pool (worktree /home/yifan_xu/MadNCL-public-pool; files committed at b99a54b, "WO-69 Addendum 4:
                     rho=1e8 pilot screens ..., S0' outputs"; source directory benchmarks/pilot/screen/out/s0p/) on 2026-11-12.
screens/<net>_A.{csv,raw.csv,meta.txt}
                     case1354pegase, case2869pegase, case_ACTIVSg2000: julia/screen_run2.jl <D>/data_mp70/<net>.m A 64
                     <out>/screens/<net>_A 1e8, the same rule, stopped at 64 admitted; run in this checkout, started
                     2026-11-12T01:21 (EST), the three in parallel (case1354pegase: 103 branches screened, 878.7 s;
                     case2869pegase: 74, 1968.1 s; case_ACTIVSg2000: 88, 1207.8 s).
islands.csv          julia/islands.jl islands.csv case118=<D>/data_mp70/case118.m case300=<D>/data_mp70/case300.m
                     case_ACTIVSg200=... case_ACTIVSg500=... case1354pegase=... case2869pegase=... case_ACTIVSg2000=...
                     (every bridge of the seven networks, 2213 rows), run in this checkout on 2026-11-13 (45 s); its rows of the
                     last four networks are byte-identical to the same script's output on those four of 2026-11-12.
k1/<budget>/<net>_<label>__<k>.csv
                     julia/k1_verify.jl, one row per outage: net, label, branch key, Ipopt status, termination, iterations,
                     unscaled constraint violation, unscaled dual infeasibility, scaled violation, scaled dual infeasibility,
                     complementarity, objective, solve time (s), build time (s), worst row family / scope / element /
                     violation at exit, nvar[, first iteration with unscaled inf_pr < 1e-6]. Model: harness scopf_model(file,
                     [k]; the gpu.jl SCOPF settings: adjust=:mpecdroop, voltage_control=:pvpq, tau_relax=0, scale_obj=1e-4,
                     scale_cc=1), Ipopt + MA57, tol 1e-8, every other Ipopt option at its default. Label A = the MATPOWER 7.0
                     file (data_mp70/; for some case1354pegase and case2869pegase rows the data/ file, identical); label Amp81 =
                     case300 on the MATPOWER 8.1 file (data/case300.m, the file of its K = 100 instance; it differs from the
                     7.0 file only in the TAP of 22 transformers, which builds the same model).
  c3_3000it_600s/    the WO-69 Addendum C3 checks at 3000 iterations and 600 s: case118 (100 rows) and case_ACTIVSg500 (56
                     rows), copied from branch scopf-pool (benchmarks/pilot/screen/out/c3_k1/rows/, committed at e1f1328) on
                     2026-11-12; same script (scopf-pool benchmarks/pilot/c3/c3_k1.jl; julia/k1_verify.jl differs only in two
                     paths) on the same MATPOWER 7.0 files. Every one ended Solve_Succeeded within that budget, which is within
                     the protocol budget a fortiori.
  k1_10000it_3600s/  the protocol budget (C3_MAXITER=10000 C3_WALL=3600 C3_FIRSTPR=1), run in this checkout, CPU (2 x Xeon Gold
                     6130), Julia 1.10.11, benchmarks/envs/screen: Ipopt.jl 1.16.0 / Ipopt_jll 300.1400.1902 (Ipopt 3.14.19),
                     HSL_jll 2025.1.19 (licensed; libhsl 17303504 bytes), JuMP 1.32.1, PowerModels 0.21.6, MathOptInterface
                     1.54.0; workers sharing one jobs file per batch, in three batches on 2026-11-12 (EST):
                       00:01-00:05, 30 workers: case300 (labels A and Amp81, 100 rows each), case_ACTIVSg200 (100 rows),
                       case_ACTIVSg500 (35 rows);
                       00:05-01:06, 30 workers: case1354pegase (9 rows), case2869pegase (16), case_ACTIVSg2000 (5) (data/
                       for the two pegase files);
                       01:38-03:14, at most 29 processes: the island-passing admitted outages without a row among the first
                       100 (case_ACTIVSg500) or 40 (case1354pegase, case2869pegase, case_ACTIVSg2000) of their screens: 9, 27,
                       24 and 24 rows.
                     The rows of the first two batches and of c3_3000it_600s/ carried another list label in their runs; here
                     the label field and the file name carry A (Amp81), and the files are otherwise byte copies of the rows.
lists.md             python3 ../../reference_networks.py report (recomputed and compared with --check).

benchmarks/out/scopf_protocol/; the files here are byte copies of their screens (csv, raw.csv, meta.txt; not the logs),
islands.csv and K = 1 row files, up to the label of the rows noted above.
